content: पातन {%a.%} [पत्-णिच् ल्यु ल्युट् वा] Felling, cutting down. .{@-नम्@} .²1 Causing to fall down, bringing or throwing down, knocking down. .²2 Throwing, casting. .²3 Humbling, lowering. .²4 Removing. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of a particular process to which minerals (<ab>esp.</ab> quicksilver) are subjected. {%<ab>N. B.</ab>%} पातनम् may have different meanings according to the noun with which it is used; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} दण्डस्य पातनम् ‘causing the rod to fall’, {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} chastising; गर्भस्य पातनम् ‘causing the foetus to fall’, causing an abortion.
